senses.gloss:
भोस् ind. A vocative particle
used in addressing persons, and
translateable by ‘oh,’ ‘sir,’ ‘oh,’
‘halloo,’ ‘ah;’ (it drops its final
visarga before vowels and soft
consonants); कः कोऽत्र भोः Ś. 2; अथि भो
महर्षिपुत्र Ś. 7; it is sometimes
repeated; भो भोः शंकरगृहाधिवासिनो
जानपदाः Māl. 3 भोस् is said to have,
in addition, the senses of ‘sorrow’
and ‘interrogation’.
